description: bench_v5: 8-task 30 Hz Spark/Moxian demonstrations in FTP-1's fixed 120-D container; 58 dimensions supervise both EE poses (9-D representation each) and 40 hand joints directly from HDF5 actions. Arm-joint and head-pose slots are zero-masked; tactile inputs are enabled. Production training requires three ordered RGB views: camera_ego_rgb, right_wrist_camera_rgb, left_wrist_camera_rgb.
